mapper.select: SELECT id, stocks_id, stocks_shortname, bar_start_time, reference_price, ma1d, ma7d, ma30d, zscore1d, zscore7d, zscore30d, return6h, return1d, return7d, return14d, low30d, high30d, width30d, position30, pct_above_30d_low, pct_below_30d_high, strategy_ready, data_quality_reason, feature_version, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM torn_stock_strategy_feature_15m WHERE bar_start_time = #{barStartTime} AND feature_version = #{featureVersion} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY stocks_id ASC

SELECT id, stocks_id, stocks_shortname, bar_start_time, reference_price, ma1d, ma7d, ma30d, zscore1d, zscore7d, zscore30d, return6h, return1d, return7d, return14d, low30d, high30d, width30d, position30, pct_above_30d_low, pct_below_30d_high, strategy_ready, data_quality_reason, feature_version, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM torn_stock_strategy_feature_15m WHERE bar_start_time >= #{startTime} AND bar_start_time <= #{endTime} AND feature_version = #{featureVersion} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY stocks_id ASC, bar_start_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT latest.id, latest.stocks_id, latest.stocks_shortname, latest.bar_start_time, latest.reference_price, latest.ma1d, latest.ma7d, latest.ma30d, latest.zscore1d, latest.zscore7d, latest.zscore30d, latest.return6h, latest.return1d, latest.return7d, latest.return14d, latest.low30d, latest.high30d, latest.width30d, latest.position30, latest.pct_above_30d_low, latest.pct_below_30d_high, latest.strategy_ready, latest.data_quality_reason, latest.feature_version, latest.deleted, latest.create_time, latest.update_time FROM torn_stocks s JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.id, f.stocks_id, f.stocks_shortname, f.bar_start_time, f.reference_price, f.ma1d, f.ma7d, f.ma30d, f.zscore1d, f.zscore7d, f.zscore30d, f.return6h, f.return1d, f.return7d, f.return14d, f.low30d, f.high30d, f.width30d, f.position30, f.pct_above_30d_low, f.pct_below_30d_high, f.strategy_ready, f.data_quality_reason, f.feature_version, f.deleted, f.create_time, f.update_time FROM torn_stock_strategy_feature_15m f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.stocks_id = s.id AND f.bar_start_time <= #{analysisTime} AND f.feature_version = #{featureVersion} ORDER BY f.bar_start_time DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest.stocks_id ASC
